name: Chilhowie Farmers' Market
description: In 325 East Lee Highway Chilhowie, VA, Chilhowie Farmers' Market raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
